unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.detail: The server reported a problem this version of the app does not recognise.

unsupported_format.title: Unsupported file type
unsupported_format.detail: That file is not one of the formats this app can read. Use JPEG, PNG or WEBP.

corrupted_image.title: Image could not be read
corrupted_image.detail: That file looks like an image but could not be decoded. It may be truncated or damaged.

file_too_large.title: File too large
file_too_large.detail: That file is larger than the {{limit}} limit.
file_too_large.detailGeneric: That file is larger than the upload limit.

image_too_large.title: Image too large
image_too_large.detail: That image is {{actual}}, which is larger than the {{limit}} limit.
image_too_large.detailGeneric: That image has more pixels than one job will process.

image_too_small.title: Image too small
image_too_small.detail: Images need to be at least {{minimum}} pixels on each side to have something to reconstruct.
image_too_small.detailGeneric: That image is too small to have anything to reconstruct.

output_too_large.title: Result would be too large
output_too_large.detail: The enlarged image would be {{projected}}, beyond the {{limit}} limit. Try a smaller upscale factor.
output_too_large.detailGeneric: The enlarged image would be beyond the size limit. Try a smaller upscale factor.

invalid_parameters.title: Invalid settings
invalid_parameters.detail: Those settings cannot be used together.

out_of_memory.title: Not enough memory
out_of_memory.detail: There is not enough memory to enhance an image this large. Try a smaller image or a lower upscale factor.

gpu_unavailable.title: GPU unavailable
gpu_unavailable.detail: GPU mode was requested but no usable CUDA device was found. Check the driver and that a CUDA build of PyTorch is installed.

storage_full.title: Storage full
storage_full.detail: The server has run out of space for new images. Older results are removed automatically; try again shortly.

model_not_found.title: Unknown model
model_not_found.detailGeneric: That model is not in the registry.

model_load_failed.title: Model failed to load
model_load_failed.detail: The model weights could not be loaded. They may be missing or incomplete.

model_download_failed.title: Model download failed
model_download_failed.detail: The model weights could not be downloaded. Check the network connection and try again.

inference_failed.title: Enhancement failed
inference_failed.detail: The model failed while processing this image.

job_not_found.title: Job not found
job_not_found.detail: That job does not exist. It may have been removed after its retention window.

job_not_completed.title: Job is not finished
job_not_completed.detail: That job has not produced a result yet.

job_cancelled.title: Job cancelled
job_cancelled.detail: That job was stopped before it finished, so no result was produced.

queue_full.title: Server busy
queue_full.detail: The server is busy with other images. Try again in a moment.

timeout.title: Timed out
timeout.detail: The server took too long to respond. It may still be starting up.

internal_error.title: Something went wrong
internal_error.detail: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

network_error.title: Network error
network_error.detail: The request could not reach the server. Check your connection.

backend_unavailable.title: Cannot reach the backend
backend_unavailable.detail: The PixelForge AI backend is not responding. Check that it is running.

malformed_response.title: Unexpected response
malformed_response.detail: The server returned a response that could not be understood.
